name: com.pg.combat
description: Damage dealing and receiving for mobs and the player: damagers and hitboxes, knockback, charge attack, mob health and health bar, damage text, combat camera/screen feedback, enemy waves, training dummy. Health comes from com.pg.health-system. Requires com.pg.health-system, com.pg.core, com.pg.pgtween and com.pg.swarm-navigation (installed together by the Git Package Installer).
author: Lucia Lunadottir

samples.description: Dodge and barrier spend your stamina: implement IStaminaSource on your stamina component. After import remove the .txt from the file name.
